# SYNESIS_E146 — Error

## Description

`concept_a` uses `TARGET`, which uses `example`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

`concept_a` uses `TARGET`, which is also an alias (uses `example`).
  Point directly to `example`: an alias always points to the concept that remains.
